text: {"lessons":["Selling winning positions felt satisfying, but a gain relative to my cost is not a reason by itself to sell; I should weigh the current portfolio and my plan.","I sold Stock B and D, then bought more of both soon after, so I should make each trade deliberate rather than react repeatedly to short-term moves.","My account value changed across periods, and these few observations do not reveal a predictable pattern; I should manage risk and diversify without assuming past price changes forecast future returns."]}
